validity.recommendation: Treat as a single-source (OPEC-only) entry and verify with an independent Aramco/engineering source before relying on it; identify or challenge the 'Depco' endpoint. Data faithfully reproduces OPEC ASB so it is NOT a GEM fabrication, but it fails the >=2-independent-sources bar and one endpoint cannot be placed. Consider flagging low-confidence / possible relabel of an internal Aramco station.
validity.researcher_notes: SOURCE-OF-RECORD TRACE: the gem.wiki stub is a bare bulk-import row (no article body); every value (owner, length, diameter) cites ONE publication -- OPEC Annual Statistical Bulletin (ref[1]=2012 p.75; ref[2]=52nd ASB 2017). I pulled both PDFs and found the exact row in Table 9.9 'Main gas pipelines in OPEC Members': asb-2017 (2016 data) line reads 'Depco/Abqaiq | Saudi Aramco | 20 | 40' and asb-2012 reads identically 'Depco/Abqaiq | Saudi Aramco | 20 | 40 | na | na'. The table header is explicitly 'Length (miles) / Diameter (inches) / Amount transported'. So the sheet's own numbers are a faithful transcription: 20 miles = 32.19 km -> GEM LengthKnown 32.00 km (correct conversion, wiki even shows '32 km / 20 miles'); Diameter 40 in direct; Owner/operator Saudi Aramco direct; Fuel=Gas (it sits in the gas-pipelines table); Capacity blank because the 'Amount transported' column is 'na'. NO SPEC ERROR -- the specs match the cited source. EXISTENCE PROBLEM: (1) the ONLY origin is OPEC ASB; the 2012 and 2017 editions are the SAME publisher and do NOT count as two independent sources. (2) No independent source anywhere names a 'Depco-Abqaiq' / 'Depco/Abqaiq' gas pipeline -- web + trade searches return only the GEM page. (3) 'Depco' is an UNIDENTIFIABLE endpoint: it matches no known Aramco gas plant, field, station, or Eastern Province town (Berri, Shedgum, Uthmaniya, Hawiyah, Haradh, Ju'aymah, Tanajib, Qatif, Aindar, Safaniya are all identifiable; 'Depco' is not) -- likely an internal Aramco station code or a transliteration artifact carried by OPEC. GULFPUB does NOT corroborate: the Dec-2025 SDE Saudi gas roster (20 features) has no 'Depco' line; the auto-suggested match 'Abqaiq-Qatif' (16 in, 14 km) is a different pipe (60% diameter delta, 56% length delta) -- a mismatch, not this line. NOT A DUPLICATE within the GEM roster: it maps 1:1 to a distinct OPEC row and no other 40-in/32-km Abqaiq gas line exists in the roster (P1913 Abqaiq-B-Shedgum is the 42-in/53-km 'Abqaiq-B/Shedgum' OPEC row, different). CLASSIFICATION is fine: OPEC files it under 'Main gas pipelines', 40-in trunk terminating at the Abqaiq hub. NET: real per its cited source and internally consistent, but zero independent corroboration and an unplaceable origin -> existence concern, not a clean pass.

routes.corridor_desc: Only one endpoint is establishable. 'Abqaiq' is the well-known Saudi Aramco oil/gas processing centre and town in the Eastern Province (approx 25.93N, 49.67E for the named town/plant complex -- approximate, from the named place, not a surveyed pipeline coordinate). The origin 'Depco' cannot be identified against any known Aramco field, gas plant, station, or Eastern Province settlement, so its position is unknown and its lat/lon are left null (not fabricated). The only geometric bound is the OPEC-stated length of 20 miles (~32 km): the origin lies somewhere within roughly a 32 km radius of Abqaiq, direction unknown. This is a very loose bound and no defensible corridor can be drawn until 'Depco' is resolved.

No route corridor should be added to the routes repo until 'Depco' is independently identified.

summary: P1925 Depco-Abqaiq: verdict=concern (existence) -- specs (32 km/20 mi, 40 in, Aramco, gas) faithfully match its ONLY source (OPEC ASB 2012+2017, one publisher), but no independent corroboration exists, GulfPub does not confirm, and the 'Depco' endpoint is unidentifiable; not a duplicate or misclassification.
